headline: Mark Zuckerberg doesn’t understand how to live
summary: This article critically examines Mark Zuckerberg's recent AI vision. It uses a personal anecdote about AI-generated motivational posters. The author suggests a perceived lack of genuine human experience in Zuckerberg's approach.

headline: Anker’s travel charger works in almost any country and is down to $20
summary: Anker's Nano Travel Adapter is currently on sale for just $20. This essential gadget can charge up to five devices simultaneously. It's highly recommended for international travelers due to its versatility.

headline: Bluesky now lets you hide reposts from that annoying person you follow
summary: Bluesky has introduced a new feature allowing users to hide reposts from specific individuals. This tool helps declutter your feed by removing unwanted shared content. It's designed to significantly improve the overall user experience.

headline: Costco’s great Switch 2 console bundle includes over $100 in free stuff
summary: Costco is offering a fantastic $499.99 Nintendo Switch 2 bundle for its members. The package includes a 256GB microSD Express card and Switch Online expansion. This deal provides over $100 in savings before a price hike on September 1st, 2026.

headline: Halloween: The Game Refused Classification in Australia, So It Won’t Be Sold in New Zealand Despite the Fact That’s a Different Country
summary: 'Halloween: The Game' was refused classification in Australia over rules against illicit drug incentives. This Australian ban mysteriously extends to prevent its sale in New Zealand. Developers have not clarified why terminology cannot be adjusted to meet regulations.

headline: AU Deals: Save $100 on a Gigabyte OLED Monitor and get Onimusha: Way of the Sword For Free
summary: Australian shoppers can save $100 on a Gigabyte OLED Monitor in a new deal. This promotion also includes a free copy of 'Onimusha: Way of the Sword'. It's a limited-time offer for gamers and tech enthusiasts.

headline: Get a 36V 500W Adult Electric Bike for $275 Shipped During the AliExpress Back to School Sale
summary: An adult electric bike is available for $275, including shipping, during the AliExpress Back to School Sale. This bike features a 36V 500W motor and can reach speeds up to 23mph. It boasts an impressive range of up to 45 miles on a single charge.

headline: Ditch the Bubble Level, the Fanttik D2 Pocket Green Laser Level Is Priced Under $30
summary: The Fanttik D2 Pocket Green Laser Level is now available for under $30. This innovative gadget offers a modern, precise alternative to traditional bubble levels. It helps users achieve perfectly straight lines and accurate measurements effortlessly.

headline: PM asks justice secretary to find way to keep PC Harper's killers in jail
summary: The Prime Minister has requested the justice secretary to explore options for keeping PC Harper's killers incarcerated. Andy Burnham expresses confidence a solution will exclude them from an early release scheme. The move aims to ensure justice for PC Harper's death.

headline: Amber heat health alerts for almost all of England as next heatwave begins
summary: Amber heat health alerts have been issued across nearly all of England. These alerts are in effect until Friday evening due to predicted high temperatures. The region is bracing for another period of extreme heat this week.

headline: Councils to get more powers to stop vape and betting shops, PM announces
summary: The Prime Minister has announced new powers for councils to restrict vape and betting shops. Andy Burnham stated town centers have been 'hollowed out' by decades of decline. This initiative aims to revitalize local high streets and communities.

headline: At least 132 killed in Colombia's largest earthquake in years
summary: A powerful earthquake in Colombia has resulted in at least 132 fatalities. Over 480 individuals have been reported injured following the tremors. Fears persist that many more people are trapped under collapsed buildings.
